verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's margins, type scale and spacing almost exactly. Its only change is moving both decorative circles fully inside the frame, which makes them heavier blobs (the left one now sits behind the text). The pill labels are tiny but the same as in the original. B pushes the whole text block about 10px from the left edge so it is jammed against the canvas. It also enlarges the headline and squeezes out the gap between the subhead and the pills, which leaves the left cluster cramped next to empty space in the middle.
